results.title: Blog - New Haven County Court Records
results.content: June’s retrospective is devoted to highlighting a selection of cases involving disease, inoculation, and death in the New Haven County and Superior Court records. There are countless cases involving or mentioning women in the New Haven County and Superior Court records. Today we will examine the first cases involving an African-descended individual that we discovered in the New Haven County County Court records as we begin our National Historical Publications and Records Commission [NHPRC] funded grant. In keeping with our goal to discover and make visible the marginalized groups who interacted with the New Haven County court system, the next upcoming posts will be about the first records we discovered of cases involving African American and Indigenous people, and the historical context in which they were created.
